styles.name: Putty retail waist apron with mitred pocket, two pen pockets and cocoa contrast ties, no tax tab — Galloping Gourmet
styles.desc: RETAIL WAIST APRON · Retail mitred pocket with 2 pen pocket stitch lines, right side as worn · Cocoa contrast waist ties · Plain black towel loop · No tax tab
fabrics: Putty 100% organic cotton 260 gsm X149ECO-AM305 (Tiajo) — main; no rating on the sheet: the lay plan's marker AP0617080 (4 per lay) is the usage
Cocoa 100% organic cotton 260 gsm X149ECO-AM307 (Tiajo) — contrast for the waist ties; no rating on the sheet (lay plan marker APTIES)
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S PUTTY 08561 — cost per metre
THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BROWN 08975 (cocoa) — for the contrast waist ties
100% organic cotton · 40° wash · no bleach · 2 dot iron · tumble dry low · dry clean. Set 4 cm down from the finished right side seam as worn.
Set 4 cm down from the right side seam as worn, on top of the care label.
Plain black tape (no OH logo), cut 56 cm. Set 5 cm in from the finished edge of the left side seam as worn. No Sage code for the plain tape.
Set into a bag, no tissue; product sticker to the bottom right-hand corner of the bag, seal the bag. The sheet names no bag code.
mfg: Make the waist ties: fold in half to enclose the raw edges, bag out one end, edgestitch the long edge.
Double turn the side seams and hem and topstitch 12 mm. Insert the waist ties. Insert the labels in the right side seam.
Neaten the waist edge: turn 1 cm and then 2.6 cm (to the width of the waist tie) and stitch down at 2.5 cm. Insert the towel loop 5 cm in from the finished edge of the left side seam as worn.
Double stitch the waist ties to secure.
Set the hem to the pocket: double turn 1 + 2 cm and topstitch 1.9 cm.
Edgestitch the pocket to the front: set 29.5 cm up from the finished hem and centrally within the width of the apron. Set 2 x pen pocket stitch lines, right side as worn, 3 cm wide x 13 cm deep.
2 stitch triangle tack to the top of the pocket to secure.
fin: Check, trim, press and fold. Set into a bag, no tissue.
Sticker set to the bottom right-hand corner of the bag. Seal the bag.
styles.note: Works order OHAPP0617110/222CTS for Galloping Gourmet, Venue Catering (JH created 19/6/17 for SR585, bulk 11/7/17; fabric amended to Tiajo X149ECO and care label changed JH 25/3/25). No embroidery, no tax tab. The sheet gives no fabric ratings: the putty is the lay plan's marker AP0617080 (1.65 m for 4, 0.4125 m each; All Costings has 0.7 m) and the cocoa for the ties has no figure. The sheet's sketch is in works-orders/OHAPP0617110-222CTS-GallopingGourmet.xlsx.
